mentions.name: Ward
mentions.description: This Chrome extension detects browser scams and phishing using lightweight LLM models, catching everything from malicious scripts on a page to grey-area misinformation on social media. It offers a local mode for added privacy, and the team bootstraps LLM costs for early users to improve detection.
mentions.problem: Non-tech-savvy people, such as elders and young children, are vulnerable to browser scams, phishing, malicious scripts, and misinformation.
mentions.audience: Elders, young children, and anyone who is not tech savvy; described as a modern antivirus for everyday browsing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Ward, a Chrome extension that detects browser scams/phishing using lightweight LLM models. Our target persona is elders, young children, and anyone who's not as tech savvy.
